head_commit.message:
Respect tmux mouse settings in fullscreen and overlays (#47399)

## Why

Codex could enable mouse capture even when the containing tmux session had mouse support turned off.

## What changed

- Probe tmux's `mouse` and `extended-keys-format` settings together, targeting `TMUX_PANE` when available.
- Suppress mouse capture when tmux explicitly reports `0` or `off`, and apply that policy across fullscreen and overlay input changes. Refresh the policy when entering or restoring the alternate screen.
- Preserve normal mouse behavior when the probe fails or the setting is unknown, and retain the keyboard-format fallback for older tmux versions.

## Testing

Add tests for pane targeting, explicit and unknown mouse settings, probe failures, keyboard fallback, and mouse-policy changes across fullscreen and overlays.

head_commit.message:
Add system proxy fallback for login and startup requests (#46562)

Login and enterprise configuration bootstrap can fail when their endpoints are reachable only through the system proxy, before cloud configuration can enable `respect_system_proxy`.

- Enable `features.system_proxy_fallback` by default, honor managed feature requirements, and prevent project configuration from changing it.
- Retry account discovery and cloud configuration GETs through the system proxy after connection failures or timeouts, bounding the initial request and body read to five seconds.
- Retry OAuth authorization-code exchange only on connection failures before any redirect, with a ten-second connection timeout. Reuse the successful client for the subsequent API-key exchange to avoid changing routes.
- Increase workspace discovery and cloud configuration timeouts to 15 and 20 seconds, respectively, to accommodate fallback.

Add coverage for proxy-only browser login through the first completed turn, including cloud configuration enabling `respect_system_proxy` without a restart. Cover stalled GET bodies, preserved request headers, disabled fallback, managed requirements, and project configuration restrictions. Verify that OAuth HTTP errors, redirects followed by connection failures, and failures after sending the POST do not trigger proxy retries, while successful redirects remain supported.

GitOrigin-RevId: 854eeeac186bb4865218ce645019c1e4bff85425

head_commit.message:
Retry transient OpenAI file blob upload failures (#47393)

## Why

A single blob upload failure previously aborted the file upload, even for a temporary `503` response or an interrupted stream.

## What changed

- Retry `503` responses and timeout, connection, body, or request errors, with at most five attempts within a shared five-minute deadline.
- Honor `x-ms-retry-after-ms` and `Retry-After`, falling back to backoff when no valid server delay is available.
- Reopen the contents for each retry while reusing the same file record and upload URL. Preserve the initial read permission check and reopen MCP file streams under the same sandbox policy.
- Record retry, recovery, and terminal failure events with a fresh client request ID for each attempt.

## Testing

Add coverage for recovery after `503` responses and interrupted streams, attempt and deadline limits, non-retryable responses, retry delay parsing, and unique request IDs. Extend the restricted-read MCP upload test to verify that both attempts send the complete file contents.

GitOrigin-RevId: 78089ecfd5076313f5784cbbc864df12d082e3b1

head_commit.message:
Retry transient OpenAI file blob upload failures (#47393)

## Why

A single blob upload failure previously aborted the file upload, even for a temporary `503` response or an interrupted stream.

## What changed

- Retry `503` responses and timeout, connection, body, or request errors, with at most five attempts within a shared five-minute deadline.
- Honor `x-ms-retry-after-ms` and `Retry-After`, falling back to backoff when no valid server delay is available.
- Reopen the contents for each retry while reusing the same file record and upload URL. Preserve the initial read permission check and reopen MCP file streams under the same sandbox policy.
- Record retry, recovery, and terminal failure events with a fresh client request ID for each attempt.

## Testing

Add coverage for recovery after `503` responses and interrupted streams, attempt and deadline limits, non-retryable responses, retry delay parsing, and unique request IDs. Extend the restricted-read MCP upload test to verify that both attempts send the complete file contents.

GitOrigin-RevId: 78089ecfd5076313f5784cbbc864df12d082e3b1
